_doc: Expected outcomes, pre-registered 10-18 before any score was computed. Tests run on the GT-as-model adapter (the GT scene rendered by the same box ray-caster that makes the GT view facts) unless noted. 'block' = every block the item has; layer3d / view / layer as in thresholds.json blocks.

T1_invariance.expect: every block score >= 0.99 on every item; |block(variant) - block(identity)| <= 1e-6 except rename_reorder variants, where the matcher must recover the identity (<= 0.01)

move_one_across.what: the unnamed element with the most 3D facts moved to its point reflected through its space centre
move_one_across.expect: layer3d < identity; drop <= 0.35 (one element); presence unchanged when the element stays in view is not required

mirror_layout.what: x -> -x for the whole scene and the cameras (the rendered views are mirror images)
mirror_layout.expect: L2 <= 0.10; L1 and S >= 0.99; screen_order <= 0.6 (above/below facts survive, left/right flip); position < identity

drop_one.what: the same element as move_one_across removed
drop_one.expect: every block <= identity; blocks drop roughly by that element's weight share (coverage)

camera_other_side.what: every GT camera reflected through its look target (position p -> 2 look - p) and looking back at the original look target
camera_other_side.expect: 3D blocks unchanged (>= 0.99); view < 0.6 (presence and pairs change)

jitter.what: xy jitter of every element, N(0, (k L)^2) per axis, k = 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.20, seed 0

shuffle_all.what: positions permuted among the elements of each space (seed 0)
shuffle_all.expect: L1, L2 <= 0.25 (one draw, not the 200-draw mean)

collapse.what: every element xy = its space centre

T5_lite.what: Spearman of the layer (and layer3d vs 5.0.9 A2, view vs 5.0.9 C1) against 5.0.9 totals over the 15 (item, model) pairs

models.expect: fake below astra and sol56 on every item in layer3d and view (the fake places named boxes only)
